snippet.description:
Learn implicit functions differentiation using partial derivatives for B.Sc. Maths. Step-by-step proof of dy/dx and d2y/dx2 formulas with solved examples.

Hello Learners! Welcome to Fractal Frontier Maths. 

Is lecture me hum discuss karenge Implicit Functions (अस्पष्ट फलन) aur Partial Differentiation ki help se unka derivative kaise calculate kiya jata hai.

📌 Is Video Me Kya Seekhenge:
• Explicit vs Implicit Functions kya hote hain aur unme kya difference hai
• Chain Rule ka use karke First Order Derivative (dy/dx = -p/q) ka complete proof
• Second Order Derivative (d²y/dx² = -(q²r - 2pqs + p²t)/q³) ka detailed derivation
• Standard notations (p, q, r, s, t) ka complete explanation
• University exam focused illustrative questions and step-by-step solved proofs

Timestamps
00:00 - Introduction & Recap of Chain Rule
01:14 - Explicit vs Implicit Functions
04:04 - Definition & Examples of Implicit Functions
06:58 - First Order Derivative (dy/dx) Formula
08:35 - Proof of dy/dx Formula Using Chain Rule
12:05 - Second Order Derivative (d²y/dx²) Derivation
17:53 - Standard Notations Explained (p, q, r, s, t)
18:58 - Example 1: Finding dy/dx for x^y + y^x = c
22:52 - Example 2: Proof of d²y/dx² for x³ + y³ - 3ax² = 0
32:40 - Example 3: Two Functions f(x, y) = 0 and φ(y, z) = 0
35:38 - Summary & What's Next (Jacobians Preview)

🎓 Yeh Video Kin Ke Liye Useful Hai:
🔸B.Sc, B.Sc B.Ed, Maths students 
🔸B.Tech Engineering Maths 
🔸GATE Mathematics 
🔸IIT JAM Mathematics

🔗 Previous Lecture:
Partial Differentiation: Change of Variables & Polar Coordinates   → https://youtu.be/y0QT6b7H3VM

📺 Complete Playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQ2PtdP6tVW8

Video pasand aaye toh Like karein aur Fractal Frontier Maths channel ko Subscribe karna na bhoolein. Koi bhi doubt ho toh comments mein zarur batayein!

📚 RECOMMENDED BOOKS / STUDY MATERIAL
If you want to study this topic in more depth, the following books are very helpful:

📘 Thomas' Calculus (15th Edition) – George B. Thomas, Maurice D. Weir & Joel R. Hass
👉 https://amzn.to/48DQjQW

📘 Single Variable Calculus (Hardcover) – James Stewart
👉 https://amzn.to/4cQeZbk

📘 Differential Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cRttb2

📘 Integral Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cReFsT

📘 Calculus, Vol. 1: One-Variable Calculus, with an Introduction to Linear Algebra – Tom M. Apostol
👉 https://amzn.to/4mBuoQ9

📘Higher Engineering Mathematics — B.S. Grewal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cz7dS7

📘Advanced Engineering Mathematics — Erwin Kreyszig
👉 https://amzn.to/41FY1pW

📘 Mathematical Methods for Physics and Engineering — K.F. Riley
👉 https://amzn.to/42cW0Sf

📘 Schaum’s Outline of Calculus
👉 https://amzn.to/4u0oxqd

Agar video helpful lage toh LIKE karein, channel ko SUBSCRIBE karein aur apne classmates ke saath SHARE karein! Koi bhi doubts ya questions ho toh comments section mein zaroor batayein.

Happy Learning! 📐✨
